biggest_catch: The standard 90-day pending period — longer at some merchants — means earnings sit locked for a full quarter before you can touch them.
catches: Cashback rates vary by store and offer; cashback is not guaranteed income.

$10 in payable rebates required to request a payout by check or PayPal.
You must click through MaxRebates and complete the purchase in the same session; broken sessions lose the rebate.
Merchant and category exclusions apply; gift-card purchases are commonly excluded.
MaxRebates tracks your purchases through affiliate links — a real privacy trade-off.

steps: Install the MaxRebates browser extension (or use the MaxRebates site) and create a free account.
Click through MaxRebates to the store and complete your purchase in the same session.
Track the rebate in your account; it posts as pending.
Wait out the normal 90-day pending period (longer at some merchants).
Once you have $10+ in payable rebates, request payout by check or PayPal.
